EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 2
EPISODE LOGLINE: Nadia and Theo break into the server room to save the backups and overhear Grant ordering her silenced.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Picking up at the Episode 1 cliffhanger: Theo gives Nadia a midnight deadline at the server room.

--- SCRIPT START ---

SCENE 01
SCENE HEADING: INT. MERIDIAN CREST TOWER – SERVER ROOM – NIGHT
SCENE START: 00:00.00
SCENE END: 01:24.70

ACTIONS AND DIALOGUE:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:02.40)
Blue server lights blink in long rows; a wall clock reads 11:52.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:04.80)
Theo swipes a borrowed key card; the lock flashes green and Nadia slips in behind him.

**NADIA (Whispering):**
Start: (00:05.10) | End: (00:07.94)
"Eight minutes. What happens at midnight?"

**THEO (Focused):**
Start: (00:08.34) | End: (00:12.54)
"An automatic purge. Every backup older than one day disappears."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:12.94) | End: (00:17.34)
Theo plugs the USB into a terminal; columns of transfers scroll across the screen.

**NADIA (Stunned):**
Start: (00:17.64) | End: (00:22.18)
"Twelve transfers. Forty-eight million dollars. All to the same shell company."

**THEO (Grim):**
Start: (00:22.58) | End: (00:26.44)
"Halcyon Bay Holdings. Look who signed the incorporation papers."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:26.84) | End: (00:29.24)
Close-up on the screen: a scanned signature beside the name SELENE MARCH.

**NADIA (Betrayed, Shaking):**
Start: (00:26.84) | End: (00:31.72)
"Selene. She slapped me in front of everyone for her own crime."

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:32.12) | End: (00:34.12)
The elevator chimes in the corridor outside.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:32.12) | End: (00:36.32)
Theo yanks Nadia down behind a server rack as the door swings open.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:36.62) | End: (00:39.02)
Low angle on polished shoes stepping into the room.

**GRANT (On phone, Cold):**
Start: (00:36.62) | End: (00:41.50)
"Yes, the girl is finished. Every newspaper runs the gala video tomorrow."

**GRANT (Menacing):**
Start: (00:41.90) | End: (00:46.78)
"But she saw the pension numbers. Make sure the auditor never testifies."

**NADIA (Terrified, Whispering):**
Start: (00:47.18) | End: (00:49.68)
"He's talking about killing me."

**THEO (Whispering):**
Start: (00:50.08) | End: (00:53.60)
"Don't move. The download needs ninety more seconds."

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:54.00) | End: (00:58.20)
The progress bar crawls to ninety percent; its glow lights Nadia's hiding spot.

**GRANT (Suspicious):**
Start: (00:58.50) | End: (01:01.00)
"Why is this terminal on?"

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:01.40) | End: (01:03.80)
Extreme close-up on the USB light blinking red.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:01.40) | End: (01:04.60)
Grant reaches toward the USB drive, then stops.

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:04.90) | End: (01:08.90)
Nadia's phone buzzes in her clutch; she smothers it against her chest.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:09.20) | End: (01:11.20)
A low buzz, then silence.

**GRANT (Deadly calm):**
Start: (01:09.20) | End: (01:12.04)
"I know someone is in here."

**ACTION:**
Start: (01:12.44) | End: (01:16.44)
Grant clicks on a flashlight and sweeps it slowly along the racks.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:16.74) | End: (01:19.14)
The beam stops on the hem of Nadia's black dress.

**GRANT (Menacing):**
Start: (01:16.74) | End: (01:22.30)
"Come out now, or I call the men who don't ask questions. Who's there?"

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (01:22.70) | End: (01:24.70)
Ominous swell. Cut to black.
